appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Monthly River Discharge Monitoring'.
Y-axis is labeled 'Discharge Level Index' with a scale from 0 to 500.
X-axis is labeled 'Month' with tick marks for 'January', 'February', and 'March'.
Y-axis has major tick marks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500.
A dashed horizontal line labeled 'Average' is drawn at the 450 level on the y-axis.
The bar for January reaches a value of 450 on the y-axis, exactly at the 'Average' line.
The bar for February reaches a value of 380 on the y-axis, below the 'Average' line.
The bar for March reaches a value of 250 on the y-axis, below the 'Average' line.

public_definitions: Review the river-discharge dashboard for the monthly monitoring cycle and assign January to the handling route that fits its discharge position relative to the monthly average level.
Base the routing decision on the reported monthly discharge figures shown in the dashboard when determining January's position relative to the monthly average benchmark.
